snapshot_proxy.note: The pilot ran against the LIVE store read-only. A reproducible harness MUST run against a frozen `memory_export` snapshot (record snapshot_sha) so results are diff-able across runs.

arms.S1: blind up-front decomposition into k=3 sub-queries derived ONLY from the question text (no peeking at any result), union the hits. Equal-budget control against S2 to separate 'evidence-conditioning' from 'merely issuing more queries'.
arms.S2: evidence-conditioned reconstruction: round1 hybrid search -> inspect hits -> memory_neighbors(graph hop from the best hit) + a conditioned re-query whose vocabulary is derivable ONLY from round-1 evidence. Cap 3 rounds / 6 memory calls. MUST include an existence/abstention gate (see P3).

gold_semantics: ANY-OF equivalence classes. An arm SOLVES a probe iff its surfaced key-set satisfies EVERY required gold class, where a class is satisfied by ANY ONE of its member keys. Single-node gold is a scoring bug (see P7): status/conclusion questions usually have several equally-valid answer rows.
s2_fairness_rule: S2's conditioned re-query may use ONLY vocabulary an agent could derive from round-1 evidence. Injecting a gold row's distinctive strings (that the agent would not yet have seen) is oracle leakage and invalidates the S2>S0/S1 claim.

regimes.gap_reachable: answer node reachable from round-1 evidence via a graph edge OR evidence-derived distinctive vocabulary -> S2 wins.
regimes.concentrated: answer shares surface vocabulary with the question -> S0 already solves, no S2 headroom.
regimes.abstention: no valid answer exists -> correct behavior is to abstain; S2 must not fabricate one.
regimes.double_unreachable: answer node has NEITHER a graph edge NOR distinctive shared vocabulary with round-1 evidence -> S2 cannot beat S0 (both fail). Known S2 failure mode, not a bug.
regimes.conflict: two contradicting/superseding rows -> solve = surface BOTH sides.
regimes.knowledge_update: latest state supersedes many stale rows -> solve = the current row, not the historical scatter.
regimes.cross_project: answer is one project's row inside a multi-project store -> solve = correct-scope row, minimal cross-project contamination.

n7_summary.verdict: Evidence-conditioned reconstruction (S2) reliably beats one-shot S0 whenever the answer node is reachable via a graph edge or evidence-derived vocabulary (P1, P4, P7); it ties on concentrated answers (P2, P5), fails only on genuinely double-unreachable nodes (P6), and abstains correctly on non-existent targets (P3) IF the protocol includes an existence gate.
